title: Figure 1: Blueshifting of infrared heat power spectrum
description: Two side-by-side plots of "Spectral Power" versus "Frequency ω" showing a bell-shaped spectrum. In the left plot, red arrows mark the "infrared" peak and a "visible" band at higher frequency; in the right plot, the curve is shifted so the arrow labeled "visible (shifted infrared)" sits at the peak. The caption reads "Figure 1. Blueshifting of Infrared Heat Power Spectrum," illustrating the text's point that a craft with an accelerated timeframe could appear blueshifted and brightened.
